name: Advanced3DMaterial
description: Adds configurable PBR, transparency, emissive, texture filtering, shadow, and rendering controls to compatible 3D objects.
author: Christopher Monhollen

eventsBasedBehaviors.name: Advanced3DMaterial
eventsBasedBehaviors.description: Controls the Three.js materials used by a compatible 3D object.

properties.name: ApplyOnCreation
properties.description: Automatically apply the configured material when the renderer object becomes available.
properties.label: Apply On Creation

properties.name: CloneMaterials
properties.description: Clone materials before editing them so changes do not affect other object instances.
properties.label: Clone Materials
